version: U²-Net u2netp (rembg v0.0.0 release) and Real-ESRGAN realesr-general-x4v3 (ONNX export at 899dc1e4); inference by tract 0.23
notes: Background removal and upscaling run in-process through the tract ONNX engine (pure Rust, no native library). u2netp.onnx is the rembg conversion of the official U²-Net weights. The Real-ESRGAN ONNX is a community export pinned by commit and SHA-256; it was verified bit-identical (max output difference 0) to an export made from the official realesr-general-x4v3.pth (SHA-256 8dc7edb9ac80ccdc30c3a5dca6616509367f05fbc184ad95b731f05bece96292) using the SRVGGNetCompact definition (num_conv=32, upscale=4).
